info.name: Oracle Cloud My Services Service Definitions Resource API

Service Definition resource, contains metadata about Purchase Entitlements, Service Entitlements and
Service Instances, default ordering is "name:asc".

params.name: domain
params.description: The identity domain name or the IDCS GUID of the resource

params.name: limit
params.description: Limits the number of resources to return

params.name: offset
params.description: Starting offset of the resources to return

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Ordering of the resources, this resource can be ordered by name
